title: Boring Is How Champions Are Made | A Discipline Short Film
lines: The same drill. The same page. The same early morning. Again.
Champions are not made on the stage. They're made in the repetition.
Motivation is exciting. Discipline is boring.
And boring is exactly why most people never finish.
Fall in love with the dull days. They are the foundation.
Because one day the crowd will clap for what you did in silence.
